content:
August is here, and we're still tracking deals on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, and AirTag 2 at the lowest price ever. But today's top story on the 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the M5 MacBook Air — we spotted a rare $200 price drop on the 24GB/512GB model alongside up to $300 off select configurations at the official Apple Certified Refurbished store, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more on that here). Beyond those deals, there are near $100 markdowns across Apple Watch Ultra 3 models, the brand new Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in black for $18, and Beats Solo Buds in transparent red down to $40. Read on for all the details below.

August AirPods deals up to $100: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2, more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Best Buy kicks off August Back to School sale: Apple gear, smart TVs from $80, dorm upgrade essentials, more

Official Apple Refurbished Store now serving up M5 MacBook Air deals at the lowest prices we've ever seen with up to $300 off

The new MacBook lineup just received a price increase, and while we've tracked deals up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is dishing out the best discounts on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We've highlighted the lowest prices we've tracked on the base model from a reputable source before, but you can also score a 24GB 15-inch model at $300 below its new MSRP at the store, available in Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is currently selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB of storage for $1,699 with free shipping. As mentioned above, this deal applies to all four colorways: Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This is a $1,900 MacBook Air, and right now at Amazon, all configurations are going for over $1,999.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299 new) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (Reg. $1,599 new) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (Reg. $1,999 new) — $300 off

Today's Apple refurb deal brings this machine back down to its old pricing and the best discount we've seen since the price hike took effect. It looks like these new MSRPs are going to stick around through the end of the year, if not longer. So while this isn't the lowest price we've ever tracked, it's a solid way to save on the M5 MacBook Air lineup if you're looking to land one this year — you likely won't see prices like this on the next-generation MacBook Air lineup until later in 2027.

Browse all the MacBook deals at the Apple Refurbished Store right here — use the filters on the left side of the page to choose the model you want.

The most affordable 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air gets a $200 discount today

Still live: 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro hits Amazon at $500 off

MacBook prices just went up, but Amazon is still offering a massive $500 discount on the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro as of this morning. This is very close to the best price we tracked before the price hike took effect. More details below.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Considering this machine's current regular price of $2,999 at Apple and other retailers, you're looking at up to $500 in savings right now. This deal applies to both the Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best discount we've tracked on this machine at major retailers since the M5 Pro price hike took effect.

Before this, the highest discount Amazon had offered on this machine was $300, but this is another $200 off on top of that.

While this price still doesn't bring us back to the level we tracked before the official price hike, what are you going to do — that's where we're at. All things considered, and given the price increase that hit this machine about a month ago, today's deal sits just $100 above the lowest price we've ever tracked.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models down to nearly $100 off at Amazon

Update: As we suspected, Amazon has now lowered the prices on some other Ultra 3 configurations as well, including the Natural Titanium case model with an Anchor Blue Ocean Band, at nearly $100 off. More details below.

While Series 11 deals have been rolling in steadily, as was the case at the start of August, Apple Watch Ultra 3 deals have been much harder to come by. But this morning, we spotted Amazon selling the Black Ultra 3 with a black One-Size Ocean Band at nearly $100 off.

Amazon is currently selling the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with a black Ocean Band for $699.99 with free shipping.

This model carries a regular price of $799, and the current discount is just shy of $100 — making it the best deal we've been able to track on a brand new unit from a reputable retailer.

Aside from the brief $150 price drop we saw during Amazon Prime Day, this deal rivals the best offers we've seen all year and ranks among the few notable discounts on Amazon worth paying attention to right now.

At the time of writing, the Black Titanium case model with the Ocean Band is the only configuration that's seeing a significant discount. But if this deal follows the pattern of the last one, we'll likely see more color options drop in price today and throughout the week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (Reg. $899)

If it's the Series 11 you're after, you can grab one right now at a much lower price:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

Brand new Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in black drops back to $18 Prime shipped with free shipping, lowest price ever (40% off)

Snag the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 today

We were impressed with the Solo Buds' built-in battery life — they're the most affordable new-generation Beats wireless earbuds you can get. However, they carry an $80 MSRP and typically go for $70 at Amazon, so grabbing them at Best Buy for just $41 with free shipping is an even sweeter deal. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals right here and keep reading for more on the Solo Buds deal below.

Best Buy is currently selling open-box transparent red Beats Solo Buds in "Excellent" condition for $40.99 with free shipping. That's nearly 50% off the MSRP and well below the $70 price for a new unit at Amazon.

  • Functional and cosmetic condition is like new.
  • Includes all accessories and parts, packaging may be different or not included.

It's certainly a more entry-level pair of earbuds, but what we're looking at here is a brand new-generation set of earbuds from Apple for just $41.

As mentioned above, according to our hands-on review, the earbuds' built-in battery alone delivers up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge. While there's no battery-equipped wireless charging case, that's plenty of juice for most users, especially at just $41. Other features include one-touch pairing, custom mics with "an advanced noise-learning algorithm for exceptional call quality," and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
